root_cause: The permanent immutable tenant sovereignty impact remains REVIEW_REQUIRED after a separate authenticated reviewer clears actual runtime operation. The old API refused any AI egress whenever immutable last_change_impact.deploymentApproved was false, even though the server-only, signed receipt and cross-domain clearance verifier independently enforced all ten approval scopes.
prevention: Bind the signed runtime receipt and authoritative policy assessment to the exact tenant, change ID and policy version before handling any model request.
Reject policy/audit mismatch, unverified signed receipt, missing or expired CSRD/privacy approval and unpinned endpoint before provider traffic.
Treat immutable historical REVIEW_REQUIRED as an outstanding assessment until separately cleared; do not mutate the original audit event merely to unblock execution.
Prevent older or different tenant approvals from releasing the current desired AI model and ensure no provider fallback.

evidence.outcome: A separately verified, server-held runtime clearance is now evaluated; live tenant/provider provisioning and authenticated E2E evidence must be proven before a production activation claim.
